title: Aggregate eval signals into contextual rollups with compact Console notifications
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Reduce noisy eval regression notifications by aggregating related failures into contextual rollups and sending compact, actionable notices from Console to downstream channels (Slack threads, PagerDuty incidents). This ticket scopes product requirements, UX mockups, routing rules, and rollout plan for the first-stage implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Console can detect and group eval failures that share: model/config change, evaluation suite, and 15-minute temporal window into a single rollup event.
Rollup payloads contain: summary metrics (delta %, baseline), top 3 failing prompts, representative examples, and links to the eval diff and run details.
Integration supports two channel formats: Slack (threaded summary + expand link) and PagerDuty (single incident per rollup with runbook link).
Configurable dedupe window (default 15m) and severity thresholds available in Console settings per project.
Notifications include a stable rollup ID so downstream dedupe and silencing can be applied without flooding.
Telemetry: Evaluations routed to rollups must surface in Console audit logs and cost/latency dashboards.
out_of_scope: Full eval signal correlation with user-facing error telemetry (will follow as a second phase).
Automatic mitigation (e.g., auto-pin previous model) — out of this ticket but will be documented for runbook handoffs.
design_notes: UX pattern: top-level banner + per-run compact card; tapping 'Expand' opens the eval diff pane with prompt examples and median token breakdown.
Slack: send a single ephemeral channel message summarizing rollup and create a thread containing top failures. Allow quick actions: mute-rollup, acknowledge, create-incident.
PagerDuty: create single incident with rollup ID and attach the run link and short remediation checklist. Use PD escalation policy configured per project.
implementation_strategy: Phase 1 (MVP): server-side rollup service in runtime orchestration layer that groups eval alerts and emits normalized 'rollup' webhook to Console. CPU-friendly, memory bounded by sliding window and TTL.
Phase 2: Console UI for rollup history, tuning dedupe window and severity thresholds, and per-project channel configs.
Phase 3: Allow customers to write custom notification transforms and add integrations (MS Teams, Opsgenie).
performance_considerations: Rollup grouping must not add >50ms median latency to eval ingest path (use async batching).
State store for rollups should be bounded and sharded by project+model to avoid global hot keys.
kpis: Reduce number of notifications per concrete regression event by >=70% in pilot projects.
Mean time to acknowledge (MTA) for eval regressions should decrease by 25% due to clearer context.
False-dedupe rate (cases where distinct regressions were merged) should be under 5% during pilot.
test_plan: Unit tests for rollup grouping heuristic (temporal+model+eval-suite).
Integration tests exercising Slack & PagerDuty flows using staging webhooks.
Canary: run with 'rollup' toggled on for two internal teams, monitor missed regression detection vs. notifications count.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-aggressive grouping could hide separate regressions. Mitigation: keep conservative default window (15m) and expose tuning controls; provide 'seen-by' prompt examples to surface diversity.
Risk: PagerDuty incident storms if mapping flawed. Mitigation: start with PD integration in 'create once' mode and require explicit escalation policy on project settings.
